comparison_reference_cache: cumulative task-seed exact-observation cache seeded from frozen initialization and extended after each sequential setting
mutable_cache: independent per-setting clone; newly completed exact-request entries merge back into the cumulative reference
resume_policy: only exact completed-run reuse; incomplete paths fail closed
source_identity: commit, dirty state, diff hash, source tree hash, script hashes
post_run_finding: the completed 2026-07-31 runs predate v2 and are invalid as strict matched-test comparisons
v2_gate: requires comparison_cache_match.json and rejects metric drift for unchanged prompt hashes
